params.name: locale
params.description: Locale code for which to retrieve translations.  For example, `fr-fr`, `de-de`, `JA-JP`.

items.docs:
Get translations bundle for a locale.
Version: 26.7.0.cl or later Retrieves all translations for a specific locale as a JSON map. Available to all authenticated users. No additional privileges are required. #### Usage guidelines - `locale` parameter must be a hyphenated locale code (for example, `fr-fr`, `de-de`, `JA-JP`). - Returns a JSON object with a `translations` map where each key is the original string and each value is the translated string
